note: Every .bind(...) call in the shipped sandbox tree is listed here, by path and enclosing function, because syntax cannot tell an ephemeral free-port probe from a listening face. A site that is not listed is refused by name (E_BIND_SITE_UNAPPROVED) until a person writes down what it is. test_*.py, vendor/ and pycrdt-poc are not scanned.
